items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 25 at 6:51AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
A strong low in the Bering Sea will continue to support wind gusts
of 30 to 40 mph across the Yukon Delta out of the east/southeast.
In Hooper Bay, minor water levels around 1 to 2 feet above the
normal high tide line are expected through this afternoon. Water
levels are expected to return to normal levels tonight into
Saturday.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 25 at 5:56AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
Strong southeast winds will increase today as a front lifts north
across the Gulf of Alaska. Timing of peak winds will be later
this afternoon through tonight, then gradually tapering Saturday.
Winds through Turnagain Arm will bend away from west Anchorage
early in the day, but could bend into Anchorage later tonight into
Saturday morning. Periods of rain will accompany the strong winds

items.areas: Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island
items.instruction:
A coastal flood warning means that flooding is occurring or
imminent. Coastal residents in the warned area should be alert
for rising water, and take appropriate action to protect life and
property.

items.description:

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued September 24 at 10:05PM AKDT until September 27 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Windy Pass.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds could blow around unsecured objects. Travel
could be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds may decrease slightly Saturday afternoon
and evening before increasing briefly overnight into early Sunday.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued September 24 at 1:57PM AKDT until September 26 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
